units.rawText: That's alright, though. If it's the Professor... whether you're curious about this outfit, or about Nanaka, feel free, Professor.

units.rawText: With the help of my love and most earnest emotions, surely I'll be able to provide the best healing I can manage. Then, shall I get started?

units.rawText: Professor, will you listen right next to me? You can get as close as you like.
